details:
* OpenJDK 11.0.33.1 release, build 1, built from the jdk-11.0.33.1+1
     tag of the upstream jdk11u repository.
     - CVE-2026-114939: Enhance Kerberos tickets (JDK-8387162)
     - CVE-2026-114940: Improve TLS client connections (JDK-8393456)
     - CVE-2026-114943: Enhance JFR Events (JDK-8389830)
     - CVE-2026-114944: Enhance JMX Connections (JDK-8391595)
     - CVE-2026-114946: Enhance loop handling (JDK-8389989)
   * Also picks up the upstream OpenJDK 11.0.32.1 and 11.0.33 (October 2026
     CPU) releases, which this branch had not been rebased to yet.
     Release notes:
     https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-08-18
     https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-10-20
     https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-10-21
     https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-10-24
     - Security fixes from 11.0.33:
       + CVE-2026-91403: java.security CA distrust (JDK-8395142)
       + CVE-2026-114820: java.security CA certificate improvements
         (JDK-8395690, advisory 2026-10-24); on Debian/Ubuntu the
         runtime trust anchors come from ca-certificates via
         ca-certificates-java
       + CVE-2026-83374, CVE-2026-83376, CVE-2026-83380,
         CVE-2026-83381, CVE-2026-83387, CVE-2026-83395,
         CVE-2026-83400, CVE-2026-87290, CVE-2026-87292,
         CVE-2026-87294, CVE-2026-87367, CVE-2026-91332,
         CVE-2026-91334, CVE-2026-91335, CVE-2026-91373,
         CVE-2026-91374, CVE-2026-91375, CVE-2026-91379,

         CVE-2026-91395, CVE-2026-91396, CVE-2026-91397,
         CVE-2026-91398, CVE-2026-91400, CVE-2026-91410,
         CVE-2026-91411, CVE-2026-91415, CVE-2026-91418,
         CVE-2026-91451, CVE-2026-91452, CVE-2026-91453,

       + CVE-2026-61308, CVE-2026-70907, CVE-2026-60589

   * Drop patches applied upstream: riscv64.diff,
     disable-thumb-assertion.patch and the tzdata2026c / CLDR metazone set
     (jdk-8380223, jdk-8381379, jdk-8390388, jdk-8390380, jdk-8388214,
     jdk-8391256, jdk-8391807).
